limitations: No executable bindings or entry integration; dynamic states remain owned by Lua.
Frozen source-formula snapshot: percentage columns and bottom tab anchor stay editable, but resizing does not rerun Lua min/max/floor.
Pen.plaque quadratic corners and slightly asymmetric Pen.circle Beziers approximated with editable rounded rectangles/circles; colors, centered stroke bounds and separate text retained.
Only road Beziers and existing icons are transparent PNG; all text, labels, plaques, portraits and buttons are editable independent nodes.
Circular source hit zones use rectangular Button bounds; exact radii recorded per node; no callbacks supplied.
Hidden completion/sync/tint/chat states are metadata, not fictitious visible content.
